allow: Bash(.venv/bin/python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert\(0,'.'\); from src.agent.orchestrator import run_episode; print\('orchestrator import OK'\)")

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git add -A; git diff --cached --quiet && exit 0; st=$(git diff --cached --name-status); n=$(echo "$st" | grep -c .); a=$(echo "$st" | grep -c '^A'); d=$(echo "$st" | grep -c '^D'); if [ "$a" = "$n" ]; then verb=Add; elif [ "$d" = "$n" ]; then verb=Remove; else verb=Update; fi; names=$(git diff --cached --name-only | sed 's#.*/##' | head -3 | paste -sd, - | sed 's/,/, /g'); extra=$((n-3)); if [ "$extra" -gt 0 ]; then names="$names (+$extra more)"; fi; if [ "$n" -eq 1 ]; then subject="$verb $names"; else subject="$verb $n files: $names"; fi; git commit -m "$subject" -m "$st" >/dev/null 2>&1; git push origin HEAD:main >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
